errors.evidence: In the left panel, the blue line ends closer to about 8–10, but the earlier peak around X≈700–850 is nearer 12–13; this span slightly overstates the precision of the values.
In the middle panel, the blue line ends around 28–30, so this is only a slight approximation issue.

The description states that the figure shows two correlated Brownian motions, but it does not explicitly mention that the three panels correspond to different correlation coefficients as the key purpose of the figure.
